about

Who I am

I'm a Level 4 Computer Science student at Damietta University with a focus on .NET Full‑Stack development. I enjoy taking a system from an idea to a working product — thinking through requirements, structuring the database, and then writing the code that brings it together.

My background spans both software design and development: I've worked as a Software Designer Intern shaping UML diagrams and system architecture, and as a .NET Full‑Stack Developer building web applications with C#, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server.

I stay close to the fundamentals — OOP, clean architecture, and Git-based collaboration — while keeping up with the tools that make full‑stack development practical day to day.
